name: split-now
description: Spending is wise, splitting is free. Split Now! Free, open-source expense splitting with bill scanning, live table splits, UPI settle-ups and optional AI.
author: Amrit Dash

scripts.typecheck:all: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-splitit "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:functions: node scripts/emulator-secrets.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-splitit "firebase emulators:exec --only functions --project demo-splitit 'vitest run --config vitest.functions.config.ts'" && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth --project demo-splitit "TRIGGERS=1 vitest run --config vitest.functions.config.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:all && npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.deploy: SPLIT_NOW_DEPLOY=1 npm run build && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:hosting: SPLIT_NOW_DEPLOY=1 npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
